settings.title: Shipping Information
settings.content:
• Free delivery for all orders in UK
  • Hassle-free returns up to 30 days after delivery
  • 24/7 customer service to answer all your questions
    We work closely with Parcelforce Worldwide, DHL, DPD to deliver all orders quickly and safely.

    This allows us to provide you with reliable tracking numbers, so you always know where your order is.

settings.title: ALWAYS PAY SECURELY
settings.content:
You can pay securely by credit card, PayPal, Google Pay and Apple Pay.

The digital transmission of your personal data, including credit card and account information, is protected by a Secure Socket Layer (SSL) connection. The protection of your data is very important to us. All personal data is treated confidentially, is not passed on to unauthorized third parties and is only used for the current process before being deleted.

settings.title: ABOUT OUR PRODUCTS
settings.content: For many years we have built strong and lasting partnerships with international designers and manufacturers, ensuring that our high standards are consistently met throughout production and the supply chain. We pride ourselves on regularly monitoring these processes to maintain the quality you expect. Sustainability and fair production practices are at the heart of our business, reflecting our deep commitment to responsible fashion and ethical trading.

settings.PinkBox_Content: We provide a no-risk 30-day money-back guarantee. If you're not happy with our product, simply email us to get a refund!

settings.title: our story
settings.text:
London Layers began with a simple yet powerful idea: to create thoughtful layering pieces that blend style, comfort, and character for women who dress with intention and ease.

At a stage in life when mainstream fashion often overlooks us, I envisioned a wardrobe designed with us in mind. A space where we feel seen, celebrated, and wholly ourselves. With London Layers, I wanted to offer clothing that embraces our bodies, supports our lifestyles, and highlights the quiet confidence that comes with time and self-knowledge.

Every fabric is carefully chosen, every cut crafted to flatter without constraining, and every detail made to last. These are layers soft, effortless, and refined. That you can reach for every day, across seasons, always feeling like your truest self.

Because real style doesn’t follow trends, it deepens with experience.

With all my heart,

Clara Whitmore – Founder of London Layers
